extracted.name: A Healthy Egg Salad
extracted.description: This healthy egg salad is so yummy and enjoyable even though it is made with low-fat mayonnaise and a 2:1 whites to yolks ratio to reduce calories.
instruction_lines: Peel and chop 8 eggs; place in a medium bowl.
Peel remaining 4 eggs. Cut each in half to remove yolks, reserving them for another use. Chop whites and add to the bowl.
Mix in mayonnaise, chives, Dijon, celery salt, paprika, kosher salt, and pepper until salad is well combined.
